post.summary: Fetch Scenario and Action Activity History
post.description:
Fetches the activity history of Scenarios and Actions in a project using a stateless cursor-based approach. Designed for clients who need to track every create, update and delete operation on Scenarios and Actions, without missing or duplicating records.

### Headers

| Header | Value |
|---|---|
| `user_id` | Login username (email) |
| `api_key` | API key of the user for authentication |
| `Content-Type` | application/json |
| `Accept` | application/json |

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accelqLoginUrl` | string | Yes | The AccelQ login URL for API access. |
| `tenantCode` | string | Yes | Tenant code for identifying the organization. |
| `projectCode` | string | Yes | Project code found under Auth properties of ACCELQ User Profile. |
| `user_id` | string | Yes | Login username (email) |
| `api_key` | string | Yes | API key of the user for authentication |

### Call patterns

**Initial call (no `cursor`)**

Omit the `cursor` field and supply the filters. `activityAfter`, `activityBefore`, `entityTypes` and `activityTypes` are required. The server returns the first page of activity within the date range and freezes the filters into an opaque cursor token returned as `nextCursor`.

**Subsequent calls (with `cursor`)**

Pass only the `cursor` field from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Do not include any filters or dates; they are already frozen inside the cursor. To change filters, make a fresh initial call without a cursor.

### Polling

- `hasMore: true` — a full page was returned. Call again immediately with `nextCursor` to retrieve the next page.
- `hasMore: false` — all matching activity has been delivered.
- **Retrieving newer activity** — activity recorded after the initial call is not included in the current cursor. Make a fresh initial call with `activityAfter` set to the `activityTime` of the most recent record received.

### Request fields

- **`actorEmails`** *(optional)* — list of email addresses of the users whose activity is to be retrieved. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted, empty or `null`, activity of all users is returned. Email addresses that do not match any user return no records.
- **`entityTypes`** *(required)* — list of entity types to include. Supported values: `ACTION`, `AUTO_SCENARIO`, `MANUAL_SCENARIO`.
- **`activityTypes`** *(required)* — list of activity types to include. Supported values: `CREATE`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`. Check-in, check-out and changes to parts of an entity, such as input parameters or test cases, are reported as `UPDATE`.
- **`activityAfter`** *(required)* — start of the time range (inclusive). Refer to the **Date rules** section.
- **`activityBefore`** *(required)* — end of the time range (exclusive). Refer to the **Date rules** section.
- **`limit`** *(optional)* — maximum number of records per page. Defaults to 100; values above 1000 are reduced to 1000.
- **`cursor`** — the `nextCursor` value from the previous response. Omit on the initial call. When a cursor is sent, all other fields must be omitted.

### Date rules

- Accepted format: ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset, e.g. `2026-06-01T00:00:00Z`.
- `activityAfter` is inclusive; `activityBefore` is exclusive.
- `activityAfter` cannot be in the future.
- `activityAfter` cannot be older than 1 year.
- If `activityBefore` is in the future, it is silently clamped to `now`.
- `activityBefore` must be after `activityAfter` (after clamping).
- The window between `activityAfter` and `activityBefore` must not exceed 90 days.

### Ordering and safe upper bound

Results are returned in descending order of when they were recorded, most recent first. A 5-second lag is applied to the upper time bound so that in-flight transactions have time to commit before they are read, preventing gaps in the results.

### Access

Tenant admins and users with a role in the project can access this API.

actorEmails.description: Optional. A list of email addresses of the users whose activity is to be retrieved. Email matching is case-insensitive. Activity of deactivated users is included. If not specified or empty, activity for all users is returned.

entityTypes.description: Required. A list of entity types used to filter the results. Valid values: ACTION | AUTO_SCENARIO | MANUAL_SCENARIO.

activityTypes.description: Required. A list of activity types used to filter the results. Valid values: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE. Check-in, check-out and changes to parts of an entity are reported as UPDATE.

activityAfter.description: Required. The start of the time range, in ISO 8601 format with a UTC offset. The start time is inclusive, cannot be in the future and cannot be older than 1 year.

activityBefore.description: Required. The end of the time range, in ISO 8601 format with a UTC offset. The end time is exclusive and must be after activityAfter. An end time in the future is treated as the current time. The time range cannot exceed 90 days.

limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of records returned in a single response. Default: 100. Maximum: 1000.

cursor.description: The pagination token returned in the nextCursor field of the previous response. Omit on the initial call. When a cursor is specified, no other request parameters can be specified; the filters from the first request are applied. To change the filters, make a new initial call without a cursor. The cursor is an opaque value and must not be modified.

200.description: Returns a page of activity records.

data.description: The list of activity records, sorted from newest to oldest.

actorEmail.description: The email address of the user who performed the activity.

activityTime.description: The date and time when the activity occurred, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

activityType.description: The type of activity. Valid values: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE.

entityType.description: The type of entity on which the activity was performed. Valid values: ACTION | AUTO_SCENARIO | MANUAL_SCENARIO.

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the Action or Scenario. The identifier stays the same across versions of the entity and is retained after the entity is deleted.

entityName.description: The name of the Action or Scenario at the time of the activity.

nextCursor.description: The pagination token for the next page of results. Pass this value as the cursor in the next request to retrieve the next page. Always returned, even when data is empty.

hasMore.description: Indicates whether more records are available. If true, more records can be retrieved using nextCursor. If false, all matching records have been returned.

'activityAfter' must be an ISO-8601 timestamp with UTC offset (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).
